title: Coconut Creek Police Department
key_finding: The official city police page describes the Coconut Creek Police Department as a full-service, fully accredited agency and presents current city-police leadership and services.

title: Commission for Florida Law Enforcement Accreditation
key_finding: The official accreditation page says the Coconut Creek Police Department has an authorized strength of 119 police officers and 44 civilian members serving approximately 60,000 residents.

title: Police Department History
key_finding: The official city history page says Coconut Creek established its own police force in 1969 and formally re-established the separate Coconut Creek Police Department on September 12, 2002, which rejects a county-replacement or contract-policing explanation.

title: Annual State Summary Crime Data Reports
key_finding: FDLE says Florida collected both summary and incident-based data during the transition after 2020 and that some agencies could not report until transition was complete.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Coconut Creek Police Department as a separate Broward municipal row with population 58,803 and total index crime 750.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report retains Coconut Creek Police Department with population 57,871 but blanks every offense field.

title: UCR Incident-Based Reports
key_finding: FDLE says the Florida incident-based reporting downloads cover the 2021-2024 and 2025 Q2 reporting cycles through an Excel workbook.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS workbook found no Coconut Creek row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets even though other Broward agencies do appear.

title: agency_rosters_2024.csv (official FBI CDE pull)
publisher: FBI Crime Data Explorer public API via repo snapshot
key_finding: The repo's 2024 official FBI CDE roster pull lists FL0061100 as Coconut Creek Police Department, agency type City, with is_nibrs false and no nibrs_start_date.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.csv
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0061100 exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1213275.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: agency_master still classifies FL0061100 as a local police department and records both SRS and NIBRS source-presence flags through 2024 even though usable public post-2020 observations are absent.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show nonzero SRS annual totals for FL0061100 in 2018-2020, then zero-valued annual SRS rows in 2021-2024 with no NIBRS support.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Coconut Creek offense controls are fully fill-backed from historical estimators because preferred reported support is zero and the dominant reporting regime is structurally_missing_or_unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.csv
key_finding: Coconut Creek is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with total_fill_count 1083.0 and total_reported_count 0.0.

title: fbi_cde_source_review_queue.csv
key_finding: The FBI CDE review queue flags FL0061100 as present_but_no_2024_observation, consistent with a valid agency identity that lacks usable 2024 reported support.
